cohort: 1055 women who gave birth between September 1, 2014, and August 30, 2017, in northern Ethiopia.
finding: Prolonged second stage of labor was significantly associated with multiple adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, including operative vaginal birth, cesarean birth, puerperal sepsis, third- or fourth-degree perineal tears, episiotomy, low 5-minute Apgar score, and meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
